propositions: rebar's LLM runtime is currently Anthropic-shaped with hardcoded provider-name string matching and refuses base_url/api_key configuration despite documented support

AWS Bedrock (the primary production path for Claude) is not supported as a first-class provider; OpenAI-compatible gateways forfeit prompt caching, native structured output, and tenacity retry/timeout
Provider selection and capability decisions must be abstracted through pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook and ModelProfile instead of inline string matching
Bedrock-hosted Anthropic models require a ModelProfile override to reflect capability differences from direct Anthropic API, enabling prompt caching via BedrockModelSettings
The signed verdict sidecar must record provider, model, endpoint host, and support tier as structured provenance so consumers can distinguish first-class from best-effort LLM calls
Retry and timeout configuration on Bedrock must be threaded through botocore.config.Config on the BedrockProvider rather than httpx/tenacity, and currently ship unconfigured in production
